# Word save fixture

`edited-markdown-extensions.docx` was generated by DocWen 0.10.0 candidate 05,
opened in Microsoft Word on Windows through Computer Use on 2026-09-06, edited
by replacing an ordinary body paragraph with `Word 实测追加：从独立 DOCX 的当前内容回转。`, and saved.
It contains synthetic text, a merged table, named caption references, H7,
an endnote and a generated image. No source Markdown accompanies the DOCX.

The fixture preserves every saved package part byte for byte except
`docProps/core.xml`, where author names and timestamps were removed. ZIP entry
timestamps and permissions were normalized. The original saved DOCX SHA-256 was
`3320ed6a6736d4ec51bb8c9bfb8c47e6bafb228280c00171320a4d49e75c5232`.

Word renumbered the custom XML parts, rewrote XML declarations and whitespace,
and replaced redundant `application/xml` overrides with the XML extension
default. It also renumbered caption styles to `af6` through `af9` while preserving
their recorded visible names. The semantic map UUIDs and document relationships
were retained.

`expanded-caption-control.docx` is a separate negative fixture. Appending a
paragraph at the end of the document while inside the final Figure content
control expanded that control from two to three blocks. Its conversion must
report invalid caption structure instead of discarding the added text. The same
metadata redaction was applied; the original saved file SHA-256 was
`65df25f800294f29e6248c06b031232f375b558a2ecaeb3e5e93df562ccf684d`.
